entries.text: 志及眾也。从人公聲。
As per 止# (stand straight) + 𠆢 a variant of 人 person → stand on tiptoes, alert to carry out a *plan*, *plot* or *scheme* (compare 跂and 僥) → *attempt* (← attempt to carry out a plan).
舉踵也。从人止聲。

As per 予# (stretch) + 人 person → servant standing erect (compare 侍 and 佇) → *fair*; *handsome* (← attractive figure ← attractive posture). The compound 倢伃 is a Han Dynasty term for a particular government official. Compare 妤.
婦官也。从人予聲。
As per 亢# (stretch) + 人 person → *stand* (← stand upright in courageous opposition); *take direct action against an opponent*. Also, *partner/opponent of equal strength*.
人名。从人亢聲。《論語》有陳伉。

As per 尹# (ruler who brings heaven and earth into harmony) + 人 person (→ human agency) → bring into harmony. *Third person pronoun* is a borrowed meaning. *Italy* is via the phonetic construction 伊太利亜 (伊太利亞), or 伊太利.
殷聖人阿衡，尹治天下者。从人从尹。
人名。从人及聲。
五# five + 人 person → (a group/company of) *five people*; (the number) *five*.
相參伍也。从人从五。

As per 支# (skillfully manipulate) → *skill*; *talent*; *ability* → *deed*. Here, 人 has no semantic function, being used simply to create a derivative character conveying meanings that dropped from the original one.
與也。从人支聲。《詩》曰：“𥷤人伎忒。”

犬 here an abbreviated form# of 犾 as described in 獄 (pair of dogs) + 人 person → pair of dogs lying curled at their master's feet → *bend/lie down*; *cover (up)*; *hide*; *obey* (← all actions commonly associated with dogs) → *bow*; *prostrate oneself*; *turn over*; *lower*; *cast down*; *lay an ambush*.
司也。从人从犬。
戈 here a variant of 戉# battle-ax + 人 person (→ human agency) → *cut down* an enemy with a weapon such as a battle-ax → *defeat* → (minor meaning of) *boast* (← boast of exploits).
擊也。从人持戈。一曰敗也。

人 person + 木 tree/wood, the latter in all likelihood a remnant of an obsolete phonetic element# that, as with other terms in Old Chinese cognate with 休, involved curvature with respect to an actual or figurative frame. The combination of elements may have suggested a person resting in the shade of a tree with curved branches, or that of a curved, wooden construction → *rest*; *stop*; *quit*. Extended meanings include *recess*; (a) *break/breather*; *holiday*; *vacation*; *day(s) off* (from work); *absence*; *sleep*; *suspend* (work); *stop* (doing); and *lay fallow*.
息止也。从人依木。

entries.text: 很也。从人，弦省聲。

人 person + 白# for the sound alone to simulate a monosyllabic term of address children would direct toward an older person of the approximate age of one's father → respected elder male → *eldest brother*; *count*; *earl*.
長也。从人白聲。
古# old + 人 person → vendor of old goods → *merchant* → *sell*; *price*; *evaluate*.
As per 半# (split) + 人 person → person who, with an *accomplice*/*associate*, splits off from a group → *accompany*; *bring with*; *involve*.
大皃。从人半聲。
As per 令# (long sequence) + 人 person → lengthy and *clever* performance given by a musician and/or *actor* → *smart*.
弄也。从人令聲。益州有建伶縣。

As per 申# (stretch) + 人 person (→ human agency) → *stretch*; *extend*; *lengthen* → *grow long/tall*; *let grow*; *develop*; *increase*; *straighten* (out); *spread*. Also, *free and easy* and *comfortable* (← relax ← stretch), *go up* (← increase), *be flattened* (← spread smooth) → *be exhausted* (← lie flat in exhaustion).
屈伸。从人申聲。
拙也。从人且聲。

As per 司# (peer through a hole): → *look in* on a person → *glance surreptitiously at*; *wait upon* (a person of high rank) → *visit*; *inquire after/about*; *consult*; *hear*. Here, 人 has no semantic function, being used simply to create a derivative character conveying meanings that dropped from the original one.
𠊱望也。从人司聲。自低已下六字，从人，皆後人所加。

As per 以# (plow furrows) + 人 person (→ human agency) → plow furrows. 似 was devised to replace 以 after 以 acquired its associated and extended meanings, but the same process occurred with 似, which acquired the meanings *resemble,* *imitate* and *copy* (← furrows of identical appearance) → *counterfeit*; *fake*.
人 + 加# to transliterate the –ga- sound such as in 伽藍 (temple/monastery). *Attend (upon)/keep another company* is via reinterpretation (person + join).
有力也。从人丕聲。《詩》曰：“以車伾伾。”
隋也。从人只聲。
象也。从人㠯聲。
癡皃。从人台聲。讀若騃。
田# field + 人 person → (tenant) *farmer* who works fields → *cultivated field*.
中也。从人田聲。《春秋傳》曰：“乘中佃。”一轅車。
As per 旦# (long and flat) + 人 person (→ human agency) → make something long and flat. *But*, *however*, *provided that* and *just* are borrowed meanings.
裼也。从人旦聲。
宁# stand tall/still + 人 person → servant (compare 侍, 伃 and 妤) standing still → *stand still* → *figure*; *appearance* (← appearance of a standing figure). Compare 竚.
久立也。从人从宁。
As per 布# (spread) + 人 person (→ human agency) → *spread*; *announce*; *publicize*.
廟佋穆。父爲佋，南面。子爲穆，北面。从人召聲。
A variant of 倔 (bend a person to one's will) with specific reference to *the crown/throne* bending others to its will in maintaining *place*/*rank*.
列中庭之左右謂之位。从人、立。

The relevant oracle bone form of this character shows heaped earth with a line underneath, indicating the bottom of a pile. Later, however, this element was replaced by 氐# (low). 低 adds 人 person → person hanging the head *low* → *lower*; *short*.
下也。从人、氐，氐亦聲。
As per 主# (stationary) + 人 person → person remaining stationary → *dwell*; *reside*; *inhabit*; *live* → *remain put*; *house*; *home*; *address*; *dwelling*.
As per 左# (assist): → *assist*. Here, 人 has no semantic function, being used simply to create a derivative character conveying meanings that dropped from the original one.
As per 右#: *protect* → *help*; *assist*. Here, 人 has no semantic function, being used simply to create a derivative character conveying meanings that dropped from the original one. Compare 侑.
As per 占# (fixed in place) + 人 person (→ human agency) → *occupy* (by force).
Originally, a depiction of a person bearing on the shoulder a load hung from a long pole. The bronzeware and seal inscription forms, though, are 人 + 可# (bend). *What* is a borrowed meaning.
儋也。从人可聲。
威儀也。从人必聲。《詩》曰：“威儀佖佖。”
它 other + 人 person → *another* person → *other*; *separate*.
負何也。从人它聲。

The relevant oracle bone form of this character is 土# pile of earth being smoothed (lazily) with a scoop, with a bronzeware inscription form adding 八 split right and left → stretch the arms to both sides to disperse surplus earth in smoothing/leveling a pile → *surplus* (← level surplus earth). In Japan, 余 was also adopted as a Shinjitai (new character form) to replace 餘, according to which 余 also conveys the meanings *remain*; *leave*; *be left over*.
語之舒也。从八，舍省聲。
失# lose + 人 person (→ human agency) → cause to *lose* sight of → *hide*; *disappear* → *loose*; *relaxed* (← act as if one's customary inhibitions have disappeared).
佚民也。从人失聲。一曰佚，忽也。

As per 弗# (split) + 人 person → person who splits away and disappears. *Buddha* is a borrowed meaning, 佛 being used to transliterate the Sanskrit buddha → *Buddhist image*; *the deceased*; *merciful*. *France* is via the phonetic construction 佛欄西.
見不審也。从人弗聲。

As per 乍# (create a pile): → *work*, in the form of making a pile by chopping/cutting → *make*; *craft*; *change into*; *crop*. Compare 似. Here, 人 has no semantic function, being used simply to create a derivative character conveying meanings that dropped from the original one.
起也。从人从乍。
As per 句# (bend) + 人 person → *stooped person*. Compare 姁 and 痀.
務也。从人句聲。
As per 仁# (interact) + 女 woman → *flatter* a woman to make her interests coincide with one's own.
巧讇高材也。从女，信省。
尓# (= 爾) (adhere) + 人 person → person with close and ongoing relations with oneself → *you*. Compare 儂. Note the variant form 儞.

The right-hand element# combines 巾 cloth + an abbreviated form of 風 (flutter) → fluttering cloth. 佩 adds 人 person (→ human agency) → *put on*/*wear* a cloth (particularly, about the waist as a belt or accessory) → *fix (to)*; *accessories*. *Be impressed* is a borrowed meaning.
大帶佩也。从人从凡从巾。佩必有巾，巾謂之飾。
合也。从人合聲。
羊 here an abbreviated form# of 徉 stray + 人 person (→ human agency) → cause to stray → *deceive*.
百# one hundred + 人 person → *leader of a hundred-man group* (compare 仟); *one hundred*.
相什伯也。从人、百。
As per 圭# (neat) + 人 person → person of neat, attractive appearance → *beautiful* (compare 娃) → *good*.
善也。从人圭聲。
佽也。从人耳聲。
并# align + 人 person (→ human agency) → align to *unite*/*join*/*combine*/*put together*.
並也。从人并聲。

並.explanation: alongside, and; common traditional writing in 并且 (bìngqiě). The 2013 standard treats this glyph as a variant of 并.
並.example: 并且 → 並且; 合并 → 合併
並.evidenceScope: Normative column classification checked; examples reflect conventional usage, not an instruction for context-free substitution.

sources.basis: 2013 Appendix 1 row 0531 lists 并 [併並竝]

併.explanation: join/merge, e.g. 合并 → 合併 (hébìng). The 2013 standard treats this glyph as a variant of 并.
併.example: 合并 → 合併; 并且 → 並且
併.evidenceScope: Normative column classification checked; examples reflect conventional usage, not an instruction for context-free substitution.

entries.text: As per 吉# (reduce/eliminate space) + 人 person (→ human agency) → pack tightly → *tightly fitted/packed*.
正也。从人吉聲。《詩》曰：“旣佶且閑。”
會也。从人𠯑聲。《詩》曰：“曷其有𠈲？”一曰𠈲𠈲，力皃。
As per 危#: *off-balanced* → *strange*. Compare 奇. Here, 人 has no semantic function, being used simply to create a derivative character conveying a nuance ("off-balanced") that dropped from 危.
偓佺，仙人也。从人全聲。
As per 兆# (split) + 人 person → person hesitant (= split) with regard to choices → *frivolity*. For "hesitant," compare 躊.
愉也。从人兆聲。《詩》曰：“視民不佻。”
As per 交# (twist/cross) + 人 person → person of an attractive, supple figure (← be supple ← twist) → *beautiful*; *handsome*. Compare 姣.
交也。从人从交。
便利也。从人次聲。《詩》曰：“決拾旣佽。”一曰遞也。
舞行列也。从人䏌聲。
吏# official (n.) + 人 person → *messenger*/*envoy* dispatched on an *errand* or *mission* → *servant*; *work for* (another) → *use* (← make use of a functionary) → *make/force to do*.
伶也。从人吏聲。
行皃。从人先聲。
寄也。从人㡯聲。㡯，古文宅。

The combination of 人 person and 口 mouth is a variant# of 信 (person speaking sincerely/truthfully). 侃 adds 川 (powerful, flowing) river → powerful sincerity → *strong and possessed of integrity/righteousness* → *strong*.
剛直也。从㐰，㐰，古文信；从川，取其不舍晝夜。《論語》曰：“子路𠈉𠈉如也。”
奇侅，非常也。从人亥聲。

A depiction of a barley plant, emphasizing the rows of pendent fruits of grain concealed in husks (compare 米). 夂 leg/foot pointed downward was added to yield a new character, 麥, meaning "come" → plant come from Central Asia. However, the meanings of 麥 and 來 were eventually inverted, so that 麥/麦 now means barley and 來/来 *come* → *since*; *until now*; *future*; *next/the coming* (week etc.) → *cause*; *bring about* (← come about).
周所受瑞麥來麰。一來二縫，象芒朿之形。天所來也，故爲行來之來。《詩》曰：“詒我來麰。”凡來之屬皆从來。
多# much/many + 人 person → person of many possessions (to the point of extravagance; compare 奓) → *extravagant*; → *luxury*. Also, *proud/arrogant* (← lord it over others ← extravagant).
掩脅也。从人多聲。一曰奢也。
𢞎詞。从人夸聲。
小皃。从人光聲。《春秋國語》曰：“侊飯不及一食。”

列# row + 人 person (→ human agency) → line objects in rows → *line up objects of the same kind*; *example*; *usual*; (the ones) *in question* → *compare* (← compare a line of similar objects); *for example*.
比也。从人𠛱聲。

As per 寺# (stand straight by): → *servant*; *retainer*; *warrior*; *samurai*. Here, 人 has no semantic function, being used simply to create a derivative character conveying meanings that dropped from the original one.
承也。从人寺聲。
As per 朱# (stump) + 人 person → *short person* (of stumpy stature).
靜也。从人血聲。《詩》曰：“閟宮有侐。”
As per 有# (extend) + 人 person (→ human agency) → extend *help/assistance* to another (compare 佑). Also, *urge another to eat* (← assist by feeding).
宴也。从人安聲。
齊等也。从人牟聲。
An abbreviated form# of 扁 (thin, flat signboard) + an abbreviated form of 合 (fit; join; put together) → neat, logical assemblage of bound records → *neat assemblage*; *neat alignment*.
思也。从亼从冊。

As per 同# (run through) + 人 person → *ignorant* (← person with a figurative hole in the head through which knowledge runs without taking hold). The character has also been applied to a particular minority group native to Hunan Province.
大皃。从人同聲。《詩》曰：“神罔時侗。”
As per 宅# (be separated) + 人 person → person separated from others → *stand apart* → *lonely*. Also, *austere refinement* (← structure such as a tea ceremony hut standing in isolation).
惕也。从人式聲。《春秋國語》曰：“於其心侙然。”
疾也。从人旬聲。

As per 共# (act jointly in making an offering ): *offer*; *serve* → *attendant*; *retinue*; *plural/humble suffix*. Here, 人 has no semantic function, being used simply to create a derivative character conveying meanings that dropped from the original one.
設也。从人共聲。一曰供給。
有廱蔽也。从人舟聲。《詩》曰：“誰侜予美？”
As per 衣# (billowing garment) + 人 person (→ human agency) → *conceal oneself* in/behind another person's billowing garment → *lean against*; *depend (upon)* → *request*.
倚也。从人衣聲。
A variant form of 俠. For meanings, see 俠.
As per 毎# (dark) + 人 person → darken another person's reputation → *be contemptuous of*; *scorn*; *despise*; *make light of*.
傷也。从人𣫭聲。

The relevant seal inscription form replaces the top element of the oracle bone form of 矣 (target) with a person, indicating a marksman hitting a lumpy target with an arrow → *lord*; *marquis* (← persons of rank at court ← meritorious soldiers). 侯 is a later form, adding 人 person for emphasis/clarity.
僮子也。从人辰聲。
安也。从人坐聲。

The right-hand element# is a variant of the right-hand element as described in 探 (penetrate). 侵 adds 人 person (→ human agency) → penetrate enemy territory in invading → *invade*; *violate*; *infringe* (on). Also, *seep in* (compare 浸).
漸進也。从人、又持帚，若埽之進。又，手也。
As per 呂# (align in a row) + 人 person → companions, people in figurative alignment → *companion* → *associate(d) with*.
徒侶也。从人呂聲。
立也。从人豆聲。讀若樹。
長皃。一曰箸地。一曰代也。从人廷聲。

The right-hand element was originally an element of uncertain composition, but the Old Chinese pronunciation of 便 suggests that this element conveyed the concept "spread" (compare 丙, a constituent element of 更). 便 adds 人 person (→ human agency) → cause to spread → *pass smoothly* → *excrement* (← offal that passes smoothly out of the body) → *easy*/*at ease* (← pass smoothly/easily) → *convenient*; *expedient* (← make something easy). Also, *letter*, *message* and *news* (of/from) (← pass word from one place to another).
安也。人有不便，更之。从人、更。
大也。从人吳聲。《詩》曰：“碩人俁俁。”

系# connection + 人 person (→ human agency) → * connect*; *link*; *lineage*; *relation* → *affect*; *modify* (a verb). *Person in charge* is via reinterpretation of the constituent elements of this character.
絜束也。从人从系，系亦聲。

entries.text: As per 足# (compress) + 人 person (→ human agency) → *press* → *urge* → *stimulate*; *draw attention to*.
迫也。从人足聲。
As per 我# (bladed weapon) + 人 person (→ human agency) → person striking suddenly with a bladed weapon or implement → *sudden* → *soon*.
行頃也。从人我聲。《詩》曰：“仄弁之俄。”
求# request + 人 person → person assuming a *reverential* attitude in supplication.
冠飾皃。从人求聲。《詩》曰：“弁服俅俅。”
緩也。从人余聲。
遠行也。从人狂聲。

夋 is as per 允 (run) + 夂 leg/foot pointed downward → stop running and stand erect. Hesitant is an associated meaning (← immobile with indecision). To 夋# (stand erect), 俊 adds 人 person → person of *quality,* *genius* and/or *excellence* (← superior posture).
材千人也。从人夋聲。
輔也。从人甫聲。讀若撫。
As per 且# (pile) + a representation of piled objects → a *stand* piled high with offerings → *cutting board*; *chopping block*. Note a variant form, 爼.
禮俎也。从半肉在且上。

As per 肖# (resemble in miniature) + 人 person → *resemble* (another person) → *disguise oneself* (← dress down or otherwise alter one's appearance so as to resemble others). Also, *be(come) thin/emaciated* (← reduced semblance of oneself).
利# sharp + 人 person → sharp/*clever* or *smart* person (compare 悧 and 怜).
As per 甬# (run through) + 人 person → *human effigy* (buried with the deceased to assist passage to the world of the dead).
痛也。从人甬聲。
完也。《逸周書》曰：“朕實不明，以俒伯父。”从人从完。
譬諭也。一曰間見。从人从見。《詩》曰：“俔天之妺。”
As per 谷# (cavity) + 人 person → person who figuratively falls into a hole (compare 禍, 陷, and 凶), becoming accustomed to *worldly*, *vulgar* ways → *customs*; *manners*.
習也。从人谷聲。
As per 孚# (envelop/enclose) + 人 person → envelop/surround captives → *captive*.
軍所獲也。从人孚聲。《春秋傳》曰：“以爲俘聝。”
訟面相是。从人希聲。
里# village + 人 person → rural inhabitant → *rural*; *countrified*; *rustic*; *vulgar*.
聊也。从人里聲。
Effectively a variant form of 勉 (make great efforts), consisting of 免# + 人 person (→ human agency): *strive*; *exhort*. *Hang the head* and *look down* are borrowed meanings.
使也。从人甹聲。

The relevant oracle bone form of this character combines 子# child + 人 person → child protected by being wrapped in a cloth (compare the replacement character 褓) and carried on the back of an adult → *protect*; *protection* → *preserve*; *maintain*; *retain*; *keep*. For the idea of enveloping a child in protection, c ompare 孚.
養也。从人，从𤓽省。𤓽，古文孚。
空中木爲舟也。从亼从舟从巜。巜，水也。
As per 矣# (come to a stop) + 人 person → *stop* and wait for someone → *wait (for/until)* → *expect*. Compare 竢.
大也。从人矣聲。《詩》曰：“伾伾俟俟。”
As per 夾# (pressed between) + 人 person → person of rank, sandwiched by bodyguards → *chivalry* (← dedicate oneself unstintingly to the service of another). *Tomboy* is a borrowed meaning.
俜也。从人夾聲。
人 person + 言# words → person speaking sincerely/truthfully → *truth*; *sincerity*; *belief*; *trust*. *News* is a borrowed meaning.
誠也。从人从言。會意。
A variant of 俟 (KUN reading まつ), created to convey the sound また with the meanings *crotch*, *groin* or *thigh*.
人 person + 弟 younger brother → a similar visage or face, as of that exhibited by one's younger brother → *trace*; *shadow*; *memory* (← similar image kept in the mind).
As per 攸# (slender and curved) + 彡 pattern → *arrange* in a slender, curving pattern → *practice*; *master* → *govern/conduct oneself*.
飾也。从彡攸聲。
As per 府# (set in place) + 人 person → assume a servile posture → *look/face down*; *bend down* → *lie prostrate*.
偕也。从人具聲。
As per 非# (spread in alignment to right and left) + 人 person → two persons performing, one on the right and the other on the left → *performer*; *actor* → *haiku*; *comic poems* (haikai).
戲也。从人非聲。
淺也。从人戔聲。

As per 表# (spread) + 人 person (→ human agency) → spread/distribute the contents of a *sack* → *counter for straw sacks* (← たわら, originally a container of woven straw in which to keep rice or charcoal, i.e., goods stored for subsequent distribution).
As per 叔# (slender and pendent) + 人 person (→ human agency) → *arrange* by hanging → *beginning* (← first step in arranging).
善也。从人叔聲。《詩》曰：“令終有俶。”一曰始也。

As per 奉# (spread/extend in presenting or receiving): → receive a *salary*. In 俸, 人 has no semantic function, being used simply to create a derivative character conveying a nuance ("receive") that largely disappeared from 奉.
奄# cover/conceal + 人 person → cover/conceal oneself. *I* and *me* are borrowed meanings.
大也。从人奄聲。

As per 卑# (low) + 人 person → a (lowly) servant (compare 婢). *Cause* (to happen) (← give orders to a servant) and *submit/obey* (← servant bending in acquiescence, then following orders) are extended senses. *Stare* is a meaning appertaining to the compound 俾倪.
益也。从人卑聲。一曰俾，門侍人。
